text: The Verdict type must have exactly four values: CONFLICT, COMPLIANT, UNCLEAR and ADR-OVERTAKEN.
quote: `Verdict` has four values: CONFLICT, COMPLIANT, UNCLEAR and ADR-OVERTAKEN.

text: UNCLEAR must be reported as a first-class result together with its reason.
quote: UNCLEAR is a first-class result, reported with its reason.

text: A judge that errors, times out or returns unparseable output must yield an UNCLEAR finding whose reason begins with `judge error`.
quote: A judge that errors, times out or returns unparseable output yields an UNCLEAR finding whose reason begins `judge error`

text: A judge error, timeout or unparseable output must never produce a COMPLIANT verdict.
Only a CONFLICT verdict may cause `adrcheck check` to exit 2 under `--fail-on conflict`.
quote: Only CONFLICT can make `adrcheck check` exit 2 under `--fail-on conflict`.

text: UNCLEAR, COMPLIANT and ADR-OVERTAKEN verdicts (including judge-error UNCLEAR rows) must not cause exit 2.
quote: Only CONFLICT can make `adrcheck check` exit 2 under `--fail-on conflict`.

text: A run in which the judge was called and no case received any verdict must exit 3.
quote: A run in which the judge was called and no case received any verdict, or in which an ADR could not be compiled because the provider failed, exits 3

text: A run in which an ADR could not be compiled because the provider failed must exit 3.
quote: or in which an ADR could not be compiled because the provider failed, exits 3

text: Exit code 3 must be distinct from exit 2 so a pipeline can distinguish an operational failure from a finding; the tool must not decide for the pipeline whether exit 3 is a stop.
quote: exit 3 is distinct from exit 2 so a pipeline can tell "the checker could not run" from "the checker found a problem"

text: A partial failure, where some cases got a verdict and others a judge error, must still exit 0 or 2 and show the errors as UNCLEAR rows.
quote: A partial failure, where some cases got a verdict and others a judge error, still exits 0 or 2 and shows the errors as UNCLEAR rows.

text: An unreachable model must not result in a green (exit 0) build or in a reported conflict.
quote: An unreachable model cannot turn a build green by accident, and cannot mark a conflict either

text: The report must show UNCLEAR counts so a run that abstained on everything is visible.
quote: The report must show UNCLEAR counts so a run that abstained on everything is visible as such.
